facts.name: Jeffrey E. Lewis
facts.assignment: Walton Circuit Division B; profile publishes civil operating procedures. No exclusive subject-matter assignment inferred.

contact.contact_note: Published office/assistant telephone shared. Assistant email is the communications route, not a separately published personal judicial email. Address spelling expanded from U.S. Hwy; no room specified.

chambers_communications.summary: Email assistant, copy counsel and unrepresented parties, identify case number/name. File and serve substantive requests; do not argue merits by email or include assistant in party coordination.

hearing_scheduling.summary: After motion appears in docket, email motion/document number, filed date, requested duration and availability. Coordinate parties, then obtain assistant confirmation before treating hearing as set. Use Central Time and file notice promptly. Email cancellations; also call for a hearing within24hours.

conferral.summary: Guide requires applicable conferral/certificate before scheduling and describes substantive conversation rather than written ultimatums. Link retained for exceptions/details.

proposed_orders.summary: Word orders through proposed-order portal with agreement cover letter; disputed post-hearing language goes to assistant by email with dispute identified and actual service addresses. Follow court deadline, stated maximum30days; do not send pre-hearing orders for holding.

courtesy_copies.summary: Submit materials at least3businessdays beforehand unless directed otherwise. Binders are specified in scheduling section; later section permits email/e-filing and asks for binders when voluminous. Source-specific routes preserved. Consult clerk for exhibit filing.

remote_appearances.summary: Zoom upon request up to1hour; longer hearings require filed motion/proposed order. All parties must agree, with no hybrid hearings. Use legal name/case number and active camera; confirm actual notice.

trial_setting.summary: Coordinate case-management conference through assistant for firm trial setting. Guide states in-person pretrial appearances unless otherwise advised.
